description: Arrêts TEC Mons is a dataset listed in Open Data Mons, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by TEC. Listing des arrêts de bus TEC à Mons. Fichier issus de leur open data: opendata.tec-wl.be - /Current GTFS/ ← Retour au catalogue complet. Coverage: Mons. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Bus, Mobilité, TEC, arrêts. The portal shows 485 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-05-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-mons-be-portal.
